## 7. v2 side-by-side (NOT like-for-like)

| | v2 (codes_v2/results/zeroday_unseen.json) | v3 (this step) |
|---|---|---|
| zero-day layer | OCSVM (nu 0.02) on the outputs of the four detectors, trained on seen attacks' detector outputs | label-free physics / rule layers + normal-only L3 + evidence-novelty (mcd) fitted on clean validation evidence |
| false alarms | benign FA 2.92% per sample (val 2% budget) | clean composite tick FA 2.73% (K), 4.78% (C) per second |
| network Bot (unseen) | zero-day layer 5.27%, supervised 0.00% | see below |
| network WebAttack (unseen) | zero-day layer 96.27%, supervised 1.17% | see below |
| lidar GhostCluster (unseen) | zero-day layer 2.87%, supervised 5.10% | see below |
| v3 network WebAttack (Web-BruteForce, Web-XSS), tick level at 1% | | rules + L3: 10.0 / 0.0%; system composites: 42.7 / 15.3% |
| v3 network Bot | | not in the one-host D10 view; M1-NET leave-one-attack-out: unseen Bot 0% (cited, not re-run) |
| v3 lidar GhostCluster | | tick level at 1%: label-free L1 100.0%; frozen domain score (with the supervised XGB) 100.0%; box cloud, physically impossible on a single-return sensor |

Protocol differences: v2 removed whole attack types from the detectors' training and scored per-sample rows of the pooled test set (Bot 5.3%, WebAttack 96.3%, D01 dedup features); v3 never trained any layer on attacks (physics / rule / normal-only), removes the held-out types from the combiner / novelty / config choices, and scores time series (1 Hz ticks, composite drives of 8-120 s with the onset inside the drive, any alarm after the onset counts).
